description.purpose: Permanent recovery rejections that corrected dead-link answers
description.usage: Inspect permanent recovery rejections recorded when dead-link answers were corrected. Each entry names the original address and rejected recovery copy.

schema.name: corrections
schema.businessName: Permanent recovery rejections that corrected dead-link answers
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One rejected recovery copy for an original dead address
schema.description: Inspect permanent recovery rejections recorded when dead-link answers were corrected. Each entry names the original address and rejected recovery copy.

properties.name: original_url
properties.description: Original dead address whose wrong recovered copy was rejected

properties.name: rejected_body
properties.description: SHA-256 of the rejected recovery copy for original_url

properties.name: decision_id
properties.description: Permanent provenance recovery rejection record identifier

properties.name: decided_at
properties.description: UTC timestamp when the rejection was recorded

properties.name: recovered_url
properties.description: Address where the rejected copy was found, when recorded

properties.name: identity_note
properties.description: Authored explanation of why the copy was rejected, when recorded

customProperties.value: original_url, rejected_body, decision_id and decided_at are required on every active rejection decision; recovered_url and identity_note are optional provenance fields.
